messages:
mira: Heads-up: cedar-v1-int4 canary is producing malformed funcall payloads when streaming. pattern: spurious control char (\\u0003) inserted inside numeric fields and occasional duplicated array items. non-stream looks fine.

mira: minimal repro (curl):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"cedar-v1-int4","prompt":"CALL tool get_scores()","stream":true,"seed":9001}'
```

mira: logged assembled output:
```json
{"tool":"get_scores","args":[{"id":0,"score":12.3},{"id":1,"score":9.8},{"id":2,"score":\u00033.1} , {"id":2,"score":3.1}]}
# note: control char in 3.1 and duplicate id 2 appended
```

oscar: wow. duplicate + embedded control char. any raw token dumps? could be kernel emitting meta-byte that our chunk assembler treats as content.

felix: paste token/chunk framing for a failing trace pls. also is this only int4 or reproducible on fp16/int8?

mira: only on int4 so far. raw chunks (trimmed):
chunks = [[11,22,255],[3,4,5,6],[7,3]]
assembled token ids = [11,22,255,3,4,5,6,7,3]  # last 3 maps to spurious control when decoded

anya: hypothesis: compressed int4 kernels reuse a scratch buffer and sometimes emit an extra sentinel byte (value 3) without proper escaping. when decoder maps that to U+0003 it lands in numeric literals, breaking JSON parse.

oscar: canary-bot metrics?

canary-bot: alert: model=cedar-v1-int4 canary: funcall-parse-error rate 2.9% (baseline 0.25%) 
link: https://canary.redwood/alerts/6187654321

felix: proposed quick mitigations:
- Immediately reduce cedar-v1-int4 streaming sampling to 0.5% (oscar)
- Add post-assembly pass that strips control chars (U+0000..U+001F) from numeric tokens before JSON parse, but ONLY for canary traces (mira)
- Add per-chunk sequence number and byte-level checksum to detect stray bytes (anya)
- Schedule quant-kernel debug run to check buffer lifetime and flush semantics (felix + runtime)

anya: agree on telemetry gating: track how often stripping repair changes bytes vs actual valid payloads. we must avoid silently hiding kernel bugs for long. add metric: postrepair_delta_pct and repaired_parse_success_count.

mira: added canary label cedar-int4-control-splice-618765. pushing a tiny post-assembly sanitizer to the canary proxy now. will add FIR filter to only strip control chars embedded in digits (regex) to minimize accidental changes.

oscar: i'll drop sampling and patch canary config. also opening infra runbook note about potential latency increase if fallback re-invokes are enabled.

felix: longer-term: instrument the PTQ int4 kernel path to zero out scratch bytes and add a tail-guard sentinel that gets escaped in tokenizer if present. i'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

mira: also saw one trace where the duplicate element landed later in the stream out-of-order. sequence header will help determine if this is emitter reorder or client reassembly bug.

anya: action items recap:
- oscar: lower sampling and pin canary label (now)
- mira: push canary-only sanitizer + collect pre/post diffs (in ~30m)
- felix: schedule kernel buffer run and add debug build for next canary (today)
- anya: add seq+checksum to chunk emitter and chart parse-vs-repair metrics (24h)

canary-bot: ticket created ML-9421: cedar-v1-int4 streaming control-char and dup-elem investigation

mira: will post one raw token-id trace once sanitizer and seq header enabled. reconvene in ~2h unless someone finds a fast mitigation. :thumbsup:
